propositions: Seven task-decomposition recommendations (R1-R7) from SOTA report must be integrated into plan-review gate with eval-based validation gated behind experiment results (E1/E2/E3/E5/E6), except R6 which ships deterministically and R7 which enables dogfooding.

Original batch-eval gating strategy for R1/R3/R4 was replaced by operator-approved advisory-first posture with bounded sanity checks and standing d8a5 effectiveness monitoring, avoiding pre-ship LLM expense while preserving safety.

E1 outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) was frozen and committed; E1's finding-adjudication and inter-rater κ≥0.7 gate were invalidated (tool-less/plan-truncated labeling ~79% contaminated) and descoped; independent human gold set parked as separate idea.

E2/E3 deterministic corpus/harness were built but their expensive LLM batch baseline was permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5 criterion_effectiveness.py (change #798); batch mining independently confirmed infeasible (~4 plan-v3 baselines vs ~200 assumed).

All 13 child experiments and recommendations (E1-E3/E5-E6, R1-R7) and standing-recorder d8a5 are closed; landed changes incorporated directly into packaged criteria_routing.json and review process with no config-flag overlay.

Blocking-FP regression is validated by R7 instrumentation against E1's outcome corpus with 10% trailing blocking-FP proxy as demotion threshold; advisory→blocking promotion gate is documented in docs/plan-review-gate.md.
